mods.name: Auto-jump
mods.description: Go ahead and jump!  Minecraft Fabric mod adding configurable auto-jumping capabilities.

releases.notes:
Answers the report in https://github.com/dbaggott/MC-MLXXXIV-jump/issues/9.

- **Renamed to Auto-jump** in game: the Mods list, the config screen, the **Toggle auto-jump** key and the action-bar messages. Your settings and key binding carry over. It is still separate from vanilla's **Auto-Jump** option under Controls, which hops you up one-block steps.
- **Jumps later, at the lip.** At an edge distance of 0 the jump now comes on the last tick you can still jump, one or two ticks later than before, so a sprint jump keeps its full takeoff distance, which is what head hitters and max-distance jumps need. At every distance, it still never lets you walk off.
- **Follows your momentum.** Sliding toward a ledge after letting go of the keys now jumps too.
- **Stairs and slabs are no longer ledges.** Walking down a staircase or a slab path no longer jumps at any edge distance, which was the misfiring at 1.00. A drop beyond them is measured along the steps.

The reset buttons on the two toggles in the config screen stay: Cloth Config gives no way to hide them.

releases.notes: Loads with older Fabric installs on Minecraft 26.3. It now needs Fabric Loader 0.19.3, Fabric API 0.160.5 and Cloth Config 26.3.158 or later, where 0.2.0 needed 0.20.1, 0.165.0 and 26.3.159, and its config screen shows in Mod Menu from 21.0.0-beta.1. Gameplay is unchanged.

mods.description: Go ahead and jump!  Minecraft Fabric mod adding configurable auto-jumping capabilities.

releases.notes:
The first release, for Minecraft 26.2 with Fabric.

- **Edge jump** jumps for you as you walk toward a ledge, once you are within a set distance of it, and always before you would fall off. It ignores ledges behind a railing, glass pane or anything else taller than a step.
- Configure the edge distance, an optional random jitter on it, and whether it works while sneaking from the **Mods** screen (with Mod Menu) or `config/mcmlxxxiv_jump.json`.
- The **Toggle edge jump** key (unbound by default, under Controls → Movement) turns it on and off.

Edge jump is off until you turn it on. Requires Fabric API and Cloth Config.
